description: RB3-730 modular taskboard reconstructed approximately from the supplied RGB/depth recording. Units are metres and degrees unless named otherwise.
coordinate_convention: Right-handed Z-up. X increases from robot/back toward front; Y+ appears right in the head camera. Layout rows are back to front, columns are image left to right (Y- to Y+). Tabletop is Z=0.
layout_provenance: Visual estimate from head frame 0 and wrist frames 460/690; small connector apertures make USB/audio/LAN/HDMI assignments provisional and editable.
robot_base_provenance: Estimated 38 cm tall rear mounting column from the external image; not calibrated. Selected pose supports all task locations.

gripper.provenance: 10 cm finger length requested by user; parallel jaws with approximate 7.5 cm opening, not the real AGILEX mechanism.

interaction.latch_limit_provenance: 330-degree travel is an adjustable approximation of the user-described obstructed sector; exact obstruction angle was not measured.
interaction.mechanism: High-level kinematic grasp, release, near-socket alignment/attachment, and constrained rotary state transitions. No insertion-force model.

estimate_provenance.method: Planar solvePnP from manually selected RGB corners with focal chosen so median board predicted optical depth/raw depth equals the unverified nominal 0.001 m/raw D455 hypothesis.
estimate_provenance.confidence: Estimated, not calibrated. Supported by relative raw-depth planarity and gradients, but depth units and RGB-depth registration remain unverified.
estimate_provenance.depth_note: Raw uint16 preserved. See depth_consistency.json for scale/focal ambiguity, residuals, table-plane consistency, and the independent D405 limitation.

depth_assumption.purpose: Camera-estimation hypothesis only; do not convert raw depths as calibrated measurements.

wrist_camera.estimate_provenance: Illustrative flange-mounted view. Intrinsics and mount offset are adjustable guesses because neither intrinsics nor hand-eye calibration was supplied.

fixture_yaw_provenance: Estimated fixture orientations from the external camera: wide HDMI face and latch/locker plates run across the image.
